THE HONEST NUMBER: entry-anchored decomposition of sealed test's mean gross +0.5150R -- by 11:30 +0.1830R (35.5%), 11:30-to-exit/15:15 +0.3320R (64.5%), 188/188 trades decomposed, additive to floating-point precision. POWER (n=188): SD 1.130%/1.790% -> mean return of only 0.165%/0.261% already clears |t|>=2, i.e. this sample is not underpowered for the clock-anchored contrast, it is simply the wrong comparison to draw a conclusion from. universe: sealed-test trades (top-200, 2023-01-01 to 2026-09-18), net R under the amended (measured) cost model -- caveat on Section 9's result, not a new finding
notes: DIAGNOSTIC ON THE EXISTING SEALED-TEST RESULT, not a new strategy, no slot spent, no rule changed. QUESTION: is 2026's weakness (net R amended +0.0731, n=50) noise or decay vs +0.5888 (2024, n=43) and +0.5770 (2025, n=47)? SELF-RAISED CAVEAT, lead with this: the bootstrap/t-test treat the 188 trades as independent draws; they cluster by stock and by market-wide day, so the true variance of a 50-trade annual mean is wider than the 0.1212 theoretical SE used here, and the resulting p=0.0006 (bootstrap) / t=-3.265 (Welch) are too small in magnitude. Direction (2026 outside ordinary per-trade-noise range for n=50) is probably right; exact magnitude is NOT established. THREE SUBSTANTIVE POINTS: (1) SETUPS DID NOT CHANGE -- move/ATR (2026 4.89 vs 2023/24/25 5.10/5.13/4.59), ORB-width/ATR (0.58 vs 0.50/0.52/0.61), trend strength at entry (1.40 vs 1.62/1.22/1.27), and band mix (2026 band101-200 share 52%, LOWER than 2023's 60% and 2025's 66%) all sit inside the 2023-2025 range -- signal generation is stable, outcomes degraded. (2) BOTH EXIT MECHANISMS MOVED TOGETHER -- 2026 lowest TARGET rate (8.0% vs 12.5%/23.3%/19.1%), highest STOP rate (10.0% vs 8.3%/4.7%/2.1%), AND TIME_EXIT cohort's own mean fell to +0.108 from +0.384(2024)/+0.361(2025) -- not one clean cause. (3) 2018 (dev, the only losing dev year, net R hi-cost -0.579, n=5) SHARES 2026'S SIGNATURE -- STOP 40%, TARGET 0%, TIME_EXIT mean -0.118; same three things moving together, but n=5 carries no statistical weight, recorded as qualitative resemblance only. OPERATIONAL CONSEQUENCE (not pre-judged): the forward paper test now answers two questions, not one -- does the edge replicate, AND was 2026 noise or the start of decay; the live log settles this on its own timeline from new trades, not more analysis of the same 188. SAMPLE SIZE COMPUTED: distinguishing a true mean of +0.47 from +0.07 at per-trade SD 0.8567 needs n=(2*0.8567/0.40)^2 ~= 19 forward trades; at the sealed test's own historical pace (188 trades / ~44.5 months ~= 4.2/month) that is ~4.5 months of live paper trading. Full detail and tables: FIBO_FINDINGS.md Section 9 caveat block (added 2026-10-10, directly above Section 10).
